mapper.select: select b.baby_id, b.baby_name, (select count(*)::int from nc_feeding f where f.baby_id = b.baby_id and f.del_flag = '0' and f.feed_time::date = current_date) as feed_count, (select coalesce(sum(f.amount_ml), 0) from nc_feeding f where f.baby_id = b.baby_id and f.del_flag = '0' and f.feed_time::date = current_date) as feed_amount_ml, (select coalesce(sum(s.duration_min), 0)::int from nc_sleep s where s.baby_id = b.baby_id and s.del_flag = '0' and s.start_time::date = current_date) as sleep_minutes, (select count(*)::int from nc_diaper d where d.baby_id = b.baby_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.record_time::date = current_date) as diaper_count, (select count(*)::int from nc_diaper d where d.baby_id = b.baby_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.record_time::date = current_date and d.stool_texture in ('watery', 'bloody', 'mucus', 'other')) as diaper_abnormal_count, (select coalesce(sum( case when c.end_time is not null then (extract(epoch from (c.end_time - c.start_time)) / 60)::int else 0 end), 0)::int from nc_cry c where c.baby_id = b.baby_id and c.del_flag = '0' and c.start_time::date = current_date) as cry_minutes, (select count(*)::int from nc_diaper d where d.baby_id = b.baby_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.record_time::date = current_date and d.diaper_type in ('pee', 'both')) as pee_count, lf.feed_time as last_feed_time, lf.operator_name as last_feed_operator, (select count(*)::int from nc_care_item i left join nc_care_log l on l.item_id = i.item_id and l.baby_id = b.baby_id and l.care_date = current_date where i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0' and (i.baby_id is null or i.baby_id = b.baby_id) and not exists ( select 1 from nc_care_hidden h where h.baby_id = b.baby_id and h.item_id = i.item_id ) and coalesce(l.completed, '0') = '0') as unfinished_care from nc_baby b left join lateral ( select feed_time, operator_name from nc_feeding where baby_id = b.baby_id and del_flag = '0' order by feed_time desc limit 1 ) lf on true where b.baby_id = #{babyId} and b.del_flag = '0'

select b.baby_id, b.baby_name, b.mom_user_name, b.birth_date, b.create_time, (select count(*)::int from nc_baby_member m where m.baby_id = b.baby_id and m.status = '0') as member_count, (select count(*)::int from nc_baby_member m where m.baby_id = b.baby_id and m.status = '0' and m.role_tag not in ('mom')) as family_member_count, (select string_agg(m.display_name, '、' order by case m.role_tag when 'mom' then 0 else 1 end) from nc_baby_member m where m.baby_id = b.baby_id and m.status = '0') as member_names, (select count(*)::int from v_nc_online_member o where o.baby_id = b.baby_id and o.online_flag = '1') as online_count, (select count(*)::int from nc_feeding f where f.baby_id = b.baby_id and f.del_flag = '0' and f.feed_time::date = current_date) as feed_count, (select count(*)::int from nc_diaper d where d.baby_id = b.baby_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.record_time::date = current_date and d.diaper_type in ('pee', 'both')) as pee_count, lf.feed_time as last_feed_time, lf.operator_name as last_feed_operator, (select count(*)::int from nc_care_item i left join nc_care_log l on l.item_id = i.item_id and l.baby_id = b.baby_id and l.care_date = current_date where i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0' and (i.baby_id is null or i.baby_id = b.baby_id) and not exists ( select 1 from nc_care_hidden h where h.baby_id = b.baby_id and h.item_id = i.item_id ) and coalesce(l.completed, '0') = '0') as unfinished_care from nc_baby b left join lateral ( select feed_time, operator_name from nc_feeding where baby_id = b.baby_id and del_flag = '0' order by feed_time desc limit 1 ) lf on true where b.del_flag = '0' order by b.baby_id desc
